source_summary: Ink-and-wash Chinese landscape with inscription area above (excluded). The usable motifs are in the lower half: layered mountains and hills on the left, a quiet water expanse, distant shore and hills, bare winter trees, a small boat with a seated figure, foreground rocks, and sparse shrubs.

motifs.name: central_ink_mountain_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the main rounded mountain massif in the left-middle of the painting, including the high central peak, adjacent sloping ridges, clustered dark ink vegetation dots, pale grey washes, dry contour lines, and the lower foothill forms that descend toward the water.
must_preserve: rounded peak silhouette with soft broken outline
layered grey wash texture on slopes
dry arcing contour strokes following the hill forms
dark oval vegetation dots scattered along ridges and gullies
small rocky protrusions embedded in the lower foothills
misty open negative space around the mountain edges

motifs.name: left_receding_peak_and_gorge
motifs.description: Isolate the paler distant peak and narrow gorge at the far left behind the main massif, including the triangular washed mountain, dark inner rock strokes, and diagonal valley edge entering from the left margin.
must_preserve: soft translucent grey triangular peak
darker craggy ink strokes inside the gorge
diagonal left-edge slope line
faint mist-softened boundaries
small dark vegetation dots near the lower slope

motifs.name: midground_shoreline_flats
motifs.description: Isolate the thin horizontal midground shoreline and flat riverbank forms behind the open water, including the low layered ink lines, small bank shapes, pale washes, and subtle horizontal reflections just below the mountains.
must_preserve: fine horizontal shoreline strokes
thin layered water/reflection lines
small dark bank accents
pale grey wash transitions
low flat landforms separating mountain from water

motifs.name: distant_right_hills
motifs.description: Isolate the faint low hills on the right horizon across the water, with soft silhouettes, light washes, and the narrow dark shoreline at their base.
must_preserve: low undulating hill silhouettes
transparent grey wash
thin dark base line along the shore
misty separation from the water
minimal sparse brushwork

motifs.name: tall_winter_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the pair of tall bare winter trees in the right foreground, including the two vertical trunks, branching crowns, sparse dark leaf clusters, and dry angular twigs extending left and right.
must_preserve: two tall wavering trunks with double contour strokes
dry-brush bark texture and pale wash inside trunks
angular leafless branches and twig tips
dark clustered leaves or needles near branch joints
crossing branch silhouettes in varied ink density
open gaps between branches

motifs.name: foreground_rock_ledge
motifs.description: Isolate the large foreground rock ledge at the base of the trees on the lower right, including the rounded rock mass, dark ink accents, grey wash, small ground strokes, and the immediate soil platform beneath the trunks.
must_preserve: rounded ledge-like rock silhouette
dark oval texture dots and short broken strokes
soft grey interior wash
heavier dark contour along the upper edge
small ground lines at the base
tree-root connection points on the rock

motifs.name: small_boat_with_seated_figure
motifs.description: Isolate the small narrow boat in the lower central water, including the long pointed hull, rib-like interior lines, faint wake, and the tiny seated figure near the stern.
must_preserve: slender pointed hull outline
parallel rib strokes inside the boat
tiny seated figure silhouette with bent posture
small dark head and body marks
faint horizontal waterline and wake
delicate light ink linework

motifs.name: lower_left_bare_shrubs
motifs.description: Isolate the sparse leafless shrubs in the lower-left foreground, including the low branching twigs, dry angular strokes, and faint ground/water marks around them, while excluding the nearby red seals.
must_preserve: thin angular twig network
dry-brush broken branch tips
low spreading shrub silhouette
faint pale wash and ground lines
asymmetrical branch spacing
empty negative space around the shrubs

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
